title: Emerging Market Trader
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Emerging Market Trader em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

Role Overview  We are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African/LATAM/Asian currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties. Key Responsibilities  FX Trading & Liquidity Management Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies , with a focus on African (e.g., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS), LATAM (ARS, BRL, MXN) and/or Asian (IDR, VDN, etc.)  on markets. Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks  across relevant regions. Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades  to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure. Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics  across EM FX markets.  Hedging Strategy & Risk Management Design and implement FX hedging strategies  to manage corporate or client-driven exposures. Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools  where relevant. Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization . Monitor risk limits, PnL, and exposure across currency books.  Trading Infrastructure & Systems Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure , including: Automated hedging engines  Liquidity aggregation systems Smart order routing Pricing and risk management tools Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers  via APIs or FIX protocols. Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring .  Market Development Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners  across emerging markets. Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs  and support new corridor launches. Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure  supporting global payments and settlement flows.  Requirements  Experience 5–10+ years of FX trading experience  in Emerging Markets. Strong experience trading African currencies , such as: Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP Experience working at: Global banks EM FX trading firms Payment / fintech companies Crypto exchanges or market makers Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades .  Technical Expertise Deep understanding of: FX market microstructure in illiquid markets  NDF markets and offshore hedging  Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks  Hands-on experience building or optimizing: FX trading systems  Hedging engines  Liquidity aggregation platforms  Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution .  Skills Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities. Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments . Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks . Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.  Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations . Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources . Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies . Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations . Strong analytical and problem solving skills Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments  Vision & Mission  OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors. OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: English Teacher
description:
Empresa está contratando English Teacher em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you! Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone. If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach! Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week. What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?  You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts. If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out. When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that! In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:  Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week! You be your own boss and set your own schedule Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone). Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.  Minimum Requirements:  Portuguese as a first language. C1 or C2 Level English Speaker University degree in English Teaching or related area. One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language. Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection. Must pass a criminal background check. Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.  Who we are:  Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Linux Systems Engineer
description:
Empresa está contratando Linux Systems Engineer em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

Linux Systems Engineer  Embedded, IoT & Edge Infrastructure DISCIPLINE: Embedded Linux SENIORITY: Mid · Senior EXPERIENCE: 3+ years STACK FOCUS: Yocto · WebKit 01 About the role  We're looking for a Linux engineer with an investigative mindset and a solid foundation in embedded systems. Short term: take hardware from third-party signage vendors, understand what's running on it, adapt our player to run reliably on top. Longer term: build our own Yocto-based image from scratch — you'll be shaping that foundation too. 02 What you'll own  Reverse engineer OS images from signage vendors — boot, drivers, app stack. Port our signage player across hardware targets (ARM, x86). Integrate OTA frameworks — SWUpdate, RAUC, A/B partition schemes. Build embedded Linux images (Yocto/OE) as we move to our own OS. Tune GPU drivers for smooth video and graphics on signage hardware. WebKit-based rendering (WPE WebKit, WebKitGTK) as primary runtime. Document ndings — BSP quirks, BIOS/UEFI behavior, integration procedures. Partner with the app team on player requirements and OS constraints.  03 What you bring  MUST NON-NEGOTIABLE 3+ years with embedded or edge Linux. Linux boot process — BIOS/UEFI, U-Boot/GRUB, initrd, device tree. Yocto or Buildroot. OTA / update frameworks — SWUpdate, RAUC, A/B partitions. GPU driver integration — Mesa, Intel, AMD, ARM Mali/Vivante. Reverse engineering mindset — analyze and document an unfamiliar OS image. Shell, C/C++, Git. Comfortable with real hardware, not just VMs.  NICE BONUS SIGNAL WebKit on embedded — WPE WebKit, WebKitGTK. Wayland / DRM-KMS display stack. Commercial signage hardware — LG webOS, Samsung Tizen, BrightSign. Docker, CI/CD pipelines. Firmware analysis — binwalk, Ghidra. Rust or Python. Networking — bridge, vlan, iptables, mDNS. Security hardening / secure boot.  04 The kind of engineer this work asks for  Thinks like an investigator. Given an unknown device, knows where to pull threads. Documents findings, not just fixes. Leaves a trail for the team. Comfortable with ambiguity. At ease with projects still taking shape. Likes making things run cleanly.On hardware they weren't designed for  APPLY Process run by a specialized technical consultancy. Candidates evaluated by engineers — real conversations, real hardware.

title: Especialista Técnico SAP I
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Especialista Técnico SAP I em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

No Grupo SBF, reunimos duas grandes forças do esporte no Brasil: a Centauro, maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina, e a Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no país. Queremos ser referência em esporte no Brasil e construir um futuro em que cada experiência com o esporte inspire, motive e transforme. E aí, que tal vestir essa camisa com a gente? Responsabilidades e atribuições  Arquitetura e Governança de Soluções (Keep the Core Clean):  Atuar como autoridade técnica e ponto focal para decisões de design em ambientes ABAP e SAP BTP. Garantir a integridade do sistema através da estratégia Keep the Core Clean, definindo padrões de arquitetura (In-app e Side-by-side) que assegurem a escalabilidade e a facilidade de futuras atualizações do ERP. Liderança Técnica e Excelência em Engenharia : Liderar a squad técnica estabelecendo e zelando por padrões de alta performance, segurança e qualidade de código (Clean ABAP). Realizar Code Reviews críticos e auditorias técnicas para garantir que as entregas do time (interno ou terceirizado) estejam alinhadas às melhores práticas de desenvolvimento. Inovação e Modernização do Ecossistema : Direcionar a adoção de tecnologias de ponta e novos modelos de programação, como SAP Fiori, RAP (Restful ABAP Programming Model) e CAP (Cloud Application Programming Model). Identificar oportunidades de inovação tecnológica que transformem processos de negócio em soluções digitais eficientes. Interface Estratégica e Tradução de Negócio : Atuar como facilitador entre as áreas funcionais, Gerentes de Projetos e o time técnico. Traduzir requisitos de negócio complexos em especificações técnicas viáveis, garantindo que as expectativas dos stakeholders sejam atendidas com soluções tecnicamente sustentáveis. Gestão do Ciclo de Vida e Mentoria : Supervisionar o ciclo de vida completo das soluções (do desenho técnico ao deploy e sustentação). Atuar como mentor técnico da equipe, promovendo a disseminação de conhecimento, resolvendo gargalos complexos e elevando o nível de senioridade técnica do time. Ambiente Tecnológico e Desafio:  Atuar em um ecossistema (Híbrido / Cloud) de alta criticidade, sendo o guardião da transição tecnológica de legados ABAP para modelos modernos no SAP S/4HANA. O escopo abrange desde o refinamento técnico de melhorias contínuas até a liderança técnica em projetos estruturantes de inovação e integração via SAP BTP. title: Senior ML engineer | Fully remote | B2B
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Senior ML engineer | Fully remote | B2B em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Fullinfo is looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer who enjoys turning messy web data into structured, reliable company intelligence. This is not a research role, management track or career step for people who mainly want to move up. It is a hands on engineering role for someone who gets satisfaction from solving complex data problems properly. About us  Fullinfo is a self funded software company building a B2B company intelligence platform. We continuously crawl the open web and turn unstructured company websites, directories, registries and industry sources into clean, searchable company profiles. The result is a global database where users can search for specific company data and actually get the right answer. The product helps sales and marketing teams search across company data in a way that feels simple on the surface, but is technically complex underneath. Think natural language search, structured filters, company enrichment, relationship detection and reliable classification across many countries, industries and languages. Fullinfo currently works with a compact team of around 11 people, including backend engineers, frontend engineers, UX UI designers, DevOps and machine learning specialists. The team is small, international and focused on people who actually build, improve and ship the product. The culture is calm, direct and quality driven. People say what they do and do what they say. There is little room for ego, politics or vague ambition talk. The best fit is someone who is quietly driven, technically strong and genuinely interested in building something that works well. This is not the environment for people who constantly reinvent their profile, chase the next title or need a lot of structure around them. It is a strong fit for stable engineers who know their craft and like working with other people who take quality seriously. Role description  As Senior Machine Learning Engineer, you will work on the intelligence layer at the heart of Fullinfo’s product. Your work turns raw, noisy and unstructured web content into trustworthy data points. This includes things like industry classification, company maturity stage, tech stack, geography served, corporate hierarchy, entity matching and relationship detection. You will write Python, build and improve ML pipelines, integrate LLMs, evaluate model quality and make sure the system keeps producing accurate results at scale. The stack includes Python, Pandas, scikit learn, Transformers, boto3, AWS Lambda, SageMaker, S3, ECS, Terraform, Go and TypeScript. You will work closely with a small engineering team, but this is not a role where someone tells you every step to take. The direction is clear, the expectations are high, and the work needs to be done properly. You need to be comfortable figuring things out, validating assumptions and improving quality without needing constant confirmation. Your work includes: • Designing and improving models for classification, entity resolution and relationship detection  • Working with noisy web scraped data across many languages and formats  • Building ML pipelines that run reliably in production  • Using LLMs for extraction, enrichment, validation and search related use cases  • Working with embeddings, RAG, fine tuning and prompt engineering where it actually adds value  • Defining evaluation metrics so model quality is measurable instead of based on gut feeling  • Monitoring deployed models and improving them over time  • Working with AWS services such as Lambda, SageMaker, S3 and ECS  • Collaborating with backend engineers on production systems and data flows This role is a strong fit for someone who enjoys deep technical problems more than status. Someone who would rather fix a broken classification result than talk about building a team under them. Requirements You bring: • At least 5 years of hands on ML engineering experience  • Strong Python skills  • Experience with libraries such as Pandas, scikit learn, Transformers and boto3  • Real production experience with ML on AWS  • Experience with LLMs, embeddings, RAG, prompt engineering or fine tuning  • Comfort working with large scale, messy and semi structured data  • Experience with JSON, NoSQL data and scraped web content  • A strong eye for correctness and data quality  • Business level English  • The ability to work independently in a small remote team  • A stable track record that shows depth, consistency and ownership Conditions  • 12 month B2B contract • Fully remote work (GMT -3), you are allowed to have a 3 hour overlap • Flat structure with direct communication • Production product with real users and real data problems • Strong technical challenge around ML, LLMs, search and company intelligence • Compensation based on senior contractor level The hiring process includes an intro call, a technical assignment and a final conversation with the engineering team. Interested? Apply trough the link and get in touch with our consultant Lars Fullinfo is exclusively partnering with Haystack People for this role. They will support you throughout the process and handle the initial screening, focusing on both your relevant experience and the soft skills that match Fullinfo’s needs.

No Grupo SBF, reunimos duas grandes forças do esporte no Brasil: a Centauro, maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina, e a Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no país. Queremos ser referência em esporte no Brasil e construir um futuro em que cada experiência com o esporte inspire, motive e transforme. E aí, que tal vestir essa camisa com a gente? Buscamos uma pessoa Cientista de Dados para atuar na frente de Alocação/Abastecimento em varejo, com foco em decisão de estoque orientada por dados (reduzir ruptura/excesso e aumentar venda/margem com nível de serviço). Essa posição é estratégica para evoluirmos a alocação como produto: vai do diagnóstico e modelagem até deploy, monitoramento, IA aplicada à decisão e mensuração de impacto, atuando em parceria com Produto, Engenharia/MLE, Planning, Logística e Negócio. Principais Responsabilidades  Liderar o desenvolvimento, evolução e operacionalização de modelos avançados de machine learning para problemas de negócio de alta complexidade. Atuar em desafios de modelagem preditiva, incluindo previsão de demanda, identificação de padrões comportamentais, otimização e apoio à tomada de decisão. Estruturar abordagens robustas de experimentação, validação e monitoramento de modelos, garantindo qualidade, confiabilidade e evolução contínua das soluções. Construir pipelines analíticos escaláveis para preparação, transformação e exploração de grandes volumes de dados. Trabalhar em parceria com times multidisciplinares para transformar problemas ambíguos em soluções analíticas aplicáveis e escaláveis. Liderar discussões técnicas sobre arquitetura analítica, boas práticas de modelagem e evolução da disciplina de ciência de dados. Explorar e desenvolver soluções baseadas em IA aplicada, incluindo agentes inteligentes, automação de processos analíticos e uso de modelos generativos quando fizer sentido para o problema. Apoiar a operacionalização de soluções analíticas em produção, incluindo monitoramento, performance e governança. Comunicar recomendações, aprendizados e trade-offs técnicos de forma clara para stakeholders técnicos e de negócio. Atuar como referência técnica para o time, apoiando o desenvolvimento de outros cientistas por meio de mentorias, revisões técnicas e disseminação de conhecimento.  Requisitos Necessários  Experiência comprovada de 6 a 8 anos em projetos de ciência de dados. Forte domínio de estatística, machine learning e experimentação. Experiência sólida em modelagem preditiva aplicada a problemas complexos de negócio, incluindo previsão de demanda e séries temporais, com domínio de algoritmos de machine learning supervisionado como XGBoost, LightGBM e CatBoost. Proficiência em Python e SQL para análise, modelagem e manipulação de grandes volumes de dados. Experiência com ambientes cloud e ecossistemas analíticos escaláveis (BigQuery, Airflow ou similares). Capacidade de transformar problemas de negócio pouco estruturados em soluções analíticas robustas. Experiência com implantação, monitoramento e evolução de modelos em produção. Forte capacidade analítica, pensamento crítico e excelente comunicação com stakeholders técnicos e não técnicos. Noções de MLOps. Sólida vivência em versionamento de código (Git), com prática de code review, padrões de branches e integração contínua.  Diferenciais  Experiência com IA generativa, LLMs e desenvolvimento de agentes. Vivência com frameworks como LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI ou similares. Experiência em varejo. Conhecimento em técnicas de visualização de dados e storytelling. Familiaridade com ferramentas de business intelligence, como Power BI.  #SeleçãoSBF #vempraSBF

title: Lead Product Designer
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Lead Product Designer em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

Who are we?  Transcenda, headquartered in the US, was founded in July 2019 and is a full-lifecycle product development company. With locations throughout Romania, Poland, Ukraine, and Brazil, Transcenda works with Fortune 500 companies and well-funded startups to help bring new products to life. Transcenda helps companies ideate new product concepts, build prototypes, design world-class solutions then engineer new commercial products. Transcenda puts people first and strives to be a changemaker by building a better world through technology. Transcenda has grown from a 5-person team to over 250 people over the past four years and plans to continue growing. About the role  This is a senior, consultancy-style design role. You'll move between leading projects end-to-end — driving discovery, aligning stakeholders, shaping direction — and rolling up your sleeves as a senior-level individual contributor when that's what the work needs. You'll be working on mature, live products where the bar is improving what exists: smoothing workflows, sharpening hierarchy, lifting conversion, and removing friction. This is not a greenfield, portfolio-piece role. If you get satisfaction from making a working product noticeably better for the people who use it every day, you'll like it here. Key responsibilities  Take ownership of design problems on assigned projects — frame the problem, drive it through discovery, design, and delivery, and bring stakeholders along the whole way. Lead or contribute on a project depending on what's needed — sometimes you're directing the design effort, sometimes you're the one in Figma producing the work. Both modes should feel comfortable. Partner closely with product managers and engineers, translating ambiguous requirements into concrete, testable design solutions and iterating against live implementations. Run the iterative cycle from low-fidelity exploration through high-fidelity delivery, with usability validation at the points where it actually changes the outcome. Facilitate workshops, design reviews, and working sessions with cross-functional and executive stakeholders. Make decisions visible and trade-offs explicit. Mentor and raise the bar for designers around you. Build durable relationships with stakeholders. Understand what they're actually trying to achieve and push back constructively when the brief is wrong.  Must haves  6–10+ years of UX/Product Design experience, ideally including time in a consultancy, agency, or embedded-team setting where you've owned client or stakeholder relationships directly. Demonstrated ability to flex between leading a project (or a small team) and contributing as a senior IC, depending on what the engagement needs. Track record of improving existing products rather than designing greenfield experiences — measurable wins on usability, conversion, or workflow efficiency. Strong visual and UI judgment for forms, workflows, CTAs, hierarchy, and layout. You can defend a layout decision on the merits. Comfort working closely with engineering against live implementations — you can read a real interface and tell us what's wrong with it before opening Figma. Ability to articulate why a design decision was made and what problem it solves, to audiences ranging from engineers to executives. Experience facilitating cross-functional workshops and leading business reviews or strategic planning sessions with senior stakeholders.  Nice to have  Background designing for regulated or enterprise domains (finance, compliance, GRC, banking, or similar). Experience designing software embedded inside third-party platforms. Familiarity with mature component libraries and design systems (MUI or similar). Experience mentoring or leveling up other designers through example and critique. Working knowledge of HTML/CSS; JavaScript a plus. Degree in Design, HCI, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent experience.

title: Lab Systems Architect
description:
Empresa está contratando Lab Systems Architect em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

ABOUT US  Syniti, part of Capgemini is the  enterprise data partner, empowering anyone who relies on data to make business-critical decisions by delivering data they can trust through a unique combination of intelligent software and experts who deeply understand the role of data in enterprise growth. At Syniti, we tackle the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. As the industry’s only pure-play data company, we combine our Data First strategy, intelligent software and team of 100% data-focused experts to turn complex data initiatives into quantifiable business success. Trusted by the Fortune 2000, Syniti helps leading businesses reconfigure the role of enterprise data from afterthought to foundational first step; enabling them to unlock valuable insights that ignite growth, reduce risk, and expand their competitive advantage. We’ve enabled more than 5,000 successful projects and we’re a trusted partner for global enterprises and organizations throughout their data journeys. Syniti’s Data First philosophy and enterprise data management platform supports data migration, data quality, data replication, data matching, master data management, analytics, data governance, and data strategy in a single, unified solution. THE ROLE  The Lab Systems Architect plays a critical role in the success of Syniti’s Education Services department by designing, implementing, and maintaining technical lab environments that support both eLearning and instructor-led training. This role ensures the seamless operation of lab systems, supports integration with learning platforms, and collaborates cross-functionally to enhance system workflows and user experience. The ideal candidate is a technically skilled, detail-oriented problem solver with a passion for enabling learning through robust infrastructure. WHAT YOU WILL DO  Learning Lab Architecture & Management  Provide technical oversight for the design, testing, provisioning, and implementation of Learning Lab environments. Manage and maintain lab snapshots, resolving configuration defects as they arise. Optimize lab usage policies in collaboration with Education Coordinators and Leadership. Monitor VM usage reports and metrics, ensuring alignment with budget and demand. Support LMS system integrations as required. Serve as the primary escalation point for lab-related issues and liaise with solution providers to resolve complex problems across all learning lab platforms.  System Administration & Support  Allocate and reset user training accounts. Stay current with new feature releases across all education platforms. Provide on-call support for lab systems used in global training programs, including availability during evenings and weekends as needed. Regularly review help desk tickets to identify recurring issues, usage patterns, and knowledge gaps. Recommend targeted training, updated documentation, or additional support resources to proactively address common challenges and improve user experience. Train internal and partner instructors on lab systems.  Cross-Functional Collaboration & Stakeholder Management  Collaborate with Training Operations, Delivery Management, IT, and Application teams to improve workflows, system functionality, and user experience. Manage stakeholder expectations and requirements related to lab systems and processes. Identify and resolve cross-functional issues to ensure company-wide alignment on lab system needs.  Reporting & Documentation  Document system configurations, best practices, and technical procedures. Own and maintain the Education Services Revenue Report, providing monthly updates to Finance. Support the creation and maintenance of Education Services forms, lists, automations, and integrations, as required.  WHAT IT TAKES  Proficiency in SQL and at least one of the following databases: Oracle, MS SQL Server, IBM DB2, or MySQL. Experience managing hypervisor solutions and SaaS platform architecture. Knowledge of Microsoft Forms, Power Automate, Power BI, and SharePoint. Experience with Windows Server and Azure Active Directory. Understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC). Strong technical writing and documentation skills. Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management abilities. Knowledge of GraphQL queries and mutations (preferred). Self-starter with a proactive approach to problem-solving. Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. Passion for education technology and continuous improvement.  Be fully aligned to our core values: Think Big  - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have. Be Curious  - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday. Take Action  - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day. Stronger Together  - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.  WHAT WE OFFER  Trust  in your talent. At Syniti you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our style. Growth . We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story. Support . We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone. Curiosity and genuine interest in you . We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating with each depicting a different journey and we want to hear them all. Recognition . We are the sum of individual achievements and we always take the time to celebrate them. An open organisation . Titles don’t define access at Syniti. We stay humble regardless of where we sit in the organisation. We want to hear every voice, listen to all the ideas and make sure everyone’s work is seen and valued.  Our Commitment to Inclusion At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team. We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.

title: Senior Treasury Analyst
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Senior Treasury Analyst em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

The Senior Treasury Analyst will be responsible for managing bank guarantees, insurance guarantees, and surety bonds across the LATAM region, ensuring compliance with contractual obligations while optimizing the company’s credit capacity and minimizing collateral requirements. The role will also support regional cash management activities, liquidity planning, and foreign exchange operations while maintaining strong relationships with banks, insurance providers, and internal stakeholders. Key Responsibilities 1. Guarantees & Surety Management (Primary Focus) • Manage the full lifecycle of guarantees, including issuance, amendments, renewals, reductions, and cancellations of bank guarantees, insurance guarantees, and surety bonds across LATAM countries. • Review guarantees wording and contractual obligations, ensuring alignment with company policies and minimizing financial and legal risk exposure. • Provide recommendations for alternative guarantee structures (insurance vs bank guarantee vs standby instruments) to optimize cost, credit utilization, and collateral requirements. • Coordinate with banks, insurance companies, and brokers to establish and maintain guarantee facilities and credit lines. • Support the negotiation of guarantee terms to reduce costs, improve conditions, and avoid or minimize cash collateral requirements. • Monitor guarantee utilization levels and facility limits, ensuring sufficient availability to support ongoing business operations and new contracts. • Maintain a guarantee tracking system/database to monitor expiration dates, renewals, and contractual obligations. • Work closely with legal, procurement, and commercial teams to review contract clauses related to financial guarantees, performance bonds, advance payment bonds, and retention guarantees. • Ensure timely release or reduction of guarantees when contractual obligations are fulfilled. • Support risk assessments related to guarantees, including country risk, counterparty risk, and insurer/bank exposure. • Assist in building and maintaining strategic relationships with financial institutions and insurers across the LATAM region. Cash Management & Treasury Operations • Monitor daily cash balances across LATAM bank accounts, ensuring adequate liquidity and compliance with corporate treasury policies. • Support regional liquidity planning and cash positioning, including funding requirements between accounts. • Execute manual payments through banking platforms, including payments related to taxes, payroll, and judicial obligations. • Maintain accurate cash forecasting and treasury reporting in the IT2 Treasury Management System. • Support the execution and documentation of foreign exchange (FX) transactions required for LATAM operations. • Monitor FX exposure and support compliance with internal treasury policies and local regulatory requirements. • Assist in maintaining bank account documentation, including the management and reporting of authorized bank account signatories. • Ensure proper documentation and reconciliation of treasury transactions, addressing any discrepancies or queries. • Support internal and external audits related to treasury activities. Stakeholder Management • Collaborate closely with Legal, Finance, Tax, and Commercial teams to ensure proper structuring of guarantees and financial obligations within contracts. • Support on maintain effective relationships with banks, insurers, and brokers to support regional treasury operations. • Act as a key contact for guarantee-related matters within the organization. Requirements Education • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or a related discipline. Professional Experience • Minimum 5 years of experience in a corporate treasury environment, with exposure to bank guarantees, surety bonds, or insurance guarantees. • Experience working with LATAM treasury operations is highly desirable. Technical Knowledge • Solid knowledge of bank guarantees, insurance guarantees, and surety bonds. • Understanding of foreign exchange (FX) operations and compliance requirements. • Experience using Treasury Management Systems (preferably IT2). • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel. Skills & Competencies • Strong analytical and financial problem-solving skills. • Ability to review contractual financial terms and assess risk exposure. • Strong negotiation skills when dealing with banks, insurers, and brokers. • Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills. • Ability to work under time-sensitive conditions and manage multiple priorities. • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills. Languages • Advanced English (required). • Intermediate Spanish (desirable). Candidatos da cidade de São Paulo - SP, residir 24 KM do escritório da Unisys localizado na (zona sul - ponte João Dias), terá ir presencial 3 vezes na semana presencial.

title: Médico Gastroenterologista
description:
Empresa está contratando Médico Gastroenterologista em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO GASTROENTEROLOGISTA NA TELADOC HEALTH\"  Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!  A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicos e Médicas Especialistas em Gastroenterologia!  Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando. *SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: * A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas. *O QUE PROCURAMOS: * Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na especialidade de Gastroenterologia , de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos; PAPEIS E RESPONSABILIDADES  Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em gastroenterologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.  Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios gastrointestinais.  Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de: conduzir anamneses virtuais para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações do sistema gastrointestinal à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais, endoscópicos e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de gravidade em gastroenterologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.  Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.  Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.  Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças gastrointestinais.  Recomendar alterações no estilo de vida, dieta e hábitos alimentares para melhorar a saúde digestiva.  Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.  Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.  Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.  Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca de problemas de saúde gastrointestinais.  Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.  Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.  Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.  Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.  Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.  Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.  Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.  REQUISITOS   Formação Acadêmica:   Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA CONCLUÍDA (ou em andamento) OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO/PÓS EM GASTROENTEROLOGIA (CLÍNICA OU CIRÚRGICA).  Certificações:   Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM); Certificado de Título de Especialista em Gastroenterologia - RQE (Emitido pelo Conselho); ou comprovante de matrícula em Residência médica. Pós ou Especialização na área; Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil);  Experiência:   Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em gastroenterologia, sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde; Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico na Atenção Primária à Saúde;  Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:   Prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios gastrointestinais. Competências Comportamentais:  Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional. Outros Requisitos Importantes:   Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Perspectivas de Carreira:  Engenheiro de Vendas Sênior → Líder de Equipe Comercial → Gerente Regional → Diretor de Vendas Sistema Remuneratório:  Salário base + Comissão + Bônus por Desempenho + Bônus por Projetos + Bônus de Final de Ano Requisitos para a Vaga:  1. Os países com vagas abertas incluem: Estados Unidos, Japão, Reino Unido, Canadá, Alemanha, Itália, Austrália, Dinamarca, Espanha, França, Coreia do Sul, Brasil e Malásia. (É exigido residir e trabalhar localmente, além de possuir planos de desenvolvimento de longo prazo na região). 2. Possuir conhecimento específico sobre componentes eletrônicos ou sobre a indústria eletrônica, compreendendo as tendências de mercado e as necessidades dos clientes. 3. Experiência na indústria de distribuição de componentes eletrônicos é um diferencial. Benefícios:  1. Desfrutar de feriados nacionais oficiais e benefícios festivos. 2. Os funcionários efetivos terão direito a gratificações por tempo de serviço, férias anuais remuneradas (de até 10 dias) e licença-maternidade remunerada. 3. A empresa organiza viagens anualmente e promove outras atividades periodicamente. 4. Convidamos regularmente profissionais de destaque do setor para treinamentos e aprendizado, além de realizarmos sessões de compartilhamento de experiências de negócios. 5. A empresa participa regularmente de feiras internacionais de eletrônicos todos os anos (nos Estados Unidos, Alemanha, Vietnã e Brasil). 6. Oferecemos treinamento remunerado abrangente, incluindo capacitação inicial sobre produtos, métodos comerciais e raciocínio estratégico, organizado em etapas para garantir uma formação sistemática, com orientação individual personalizada (mentoria 1 a 1). 7. O período de experiência inclui o recebimento de comissões, e há dois dias de folga aos finais de semana. Requisitos e Habilidades:  1. Graduação (nível superior) ou formação acadêmica superior; a área de formação é flexível (preferência para cursos em Engenharia Eletrônica ou Marketing). 2. Boas habilidades de escuta, fala, leitura e escrita; proficiência no uso do idioma inglês para comunicação e negociação com clientes. 3. Boas habilidades de comunicação, coordenação e execução; capacidade de resposta rápida e perspicaz; forte senso de responsabilidade. 4. Experiência em técnicas e estratégias de vendas, incluindo habilidades de apresentação e negociação. 5. Forte capacidade de aprendizado e espírito de busca por aprendizado contínuo. 6. Aspiração em atuar e paixão pelo setor de comércio exterior e e-commerce. 7. Bom espírito de equipe.

Crinetics is a pharmaceutical company headquartered in San Diego, California, with a growing presence in Latin America, including an office in Brazil. We are developing much-needed therapies for people with endocrine diseases and endocrine-related tumors. We were founded by a dedicated team of scientists with the simple belief that better therapies developed from rigorous innovation can lead to better lives. Our work continues to make a real difference in the lives of patients. We have a prolific discovery engine and a robust preclinical and clinical development pipeline. We are driven by science with a patient-centric and team-oriented culture. Crinetics is known for its inclusive workplace culture. This is an exciting time to join Crinetics as we expand our operations in Latin America and shape our organization into the world’s premier fully integrated endocrine company from discovery to patients. Join our team as we transform the lives of others. Position Summary:  Please note, the candidate for this role will need to be located in Brazil.  The Regional Study Director, LATAM is responsible for managing the execution of clinical studies and data collection within the LATAM region. The incumbent will serve as a regional clinical study lead who oversees the review, monitoring, and adherence to clinical protocols, as well as managing and building relationships with clinical sites in LATAM. The Regional Study Director, LATAM may oversee other regional study leads within the region to facilitate a streamlined and quality study execution. This role will also work internally and externally with members of the cross-functional study team. Essential Job Functions and Responsibilities:  These may include but are not limited to: Provide oversight of clinical research studies for LATAM. Manage and build relationships with clinical research sites in LATAM. May oversee the work of other regional study leads within LATAM. Provide operational and strategic input into study documents such as synopsis, protocol, ICF, CRFs, CRF Completion Guidelines, Study Execution Plans, Clinical Data Review Plan, Clinical Database edit specifications, Clinical Study Report (CSR) development, etc. Oversight of all regional vendors and activities including CROs. Oversee regional start up activities including site selection, enrollment projections and activities driving site activation. Develop region specific the subject recruitment/retention strategy and related initiatives. Oversight of regional TMF ongoing quality review, and final reconciliation of study documents including review of site regulatory documents/packages and obtaining of appropriate site insurance, and/or supervision of team members performing these activities. Development of training materials for study team, investigational sites, and vendors. Proactive management of information sharing with key stakeholders using standardized reports and other mechanisms. Assure clinical studies are compliant with GDPR, ICH/GCP and other regulations as appropriate. Outline regional activation hurdles for team. Participate in RFP development and prepare bid templates to facilitate selection of the CROs/vendors, and/or collaboration/supervision with team members performing these activities. Collaborate with counsel to negotiate and draft research contracts and agreements with CROs/vendors and clinical study sites, as needed. Acts as liaison with Regulatory Affairs to assure adherence to GDPR, GCPs; maintenance of SOPs; and assure site and CRO/vendor audits are completed. Perform regional risk management and implement mitigations. Identify potential study issues and recommend and implement solutions or corrective actions as needed. Create realistic plans that clearly define goals, milestones, responsibilities, and results. Maintain focus on strategic objectives while accomplishing operational goals. Make timely, data-driven decisions. Manage daily activities, assign tasks, goals, and development of direct reports. Other duties as assigned.  Required Education and Experience:   Bachelor’s degree required, preferably in scientific discipline. An equivalent combination of relevant education and applicable job experience may be considered. 12 years of prior clinical operations experience preferably with CRO/small biotech experience and approximately 8 years of experience in a supervisory role. Must be able to travel 25-50% of time, may be higher in accordance with project requirements. Computer skills should include proficiency with Microsoft Office suite of software, electronic TMF systems, IXRS and EDC systems. Excellent understanding of drug development process. Experience in clinical trial supply management. Able to make appropriate decisions to move the project(s) forward. Effective verbal and written communication skills. Data flow from sites to data processing, review, and resolution. Analysis and report generation. Knowledge of local regulatory requirements. Ability to handle multiple tasks to meet deadlines in a dynamic environment is essential. Study initiation procedures. Ability to exercise judgment and determine appropriate action  Travel:   You may be required to travel for up to 25-50% of your time.

Diferenciais desejáveis:  ● Conhecimento em acessibilidade web, HTML semântico e hierarquia de páginas. ● Repertório em análise de funis, proposta de valor e argumentação de conversão. ● Interesse constante por tendências de CRO, UX, Growth e Inteligência Artificial. ● Experiência atuando simultaneamente em múltiplos projetos e clientes. title: Engenheiro de IA Sênior
description:
Empresa está contratando Engenheiro de IA Sênior em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) de IA Sênior  para assumir a manutenção e a evolução contínua do Plataforma Agents de IA  — nosso framework de orquestração de agentes de IA que automatiza ciclos completos de desenvolvimento de software (refinement → dev →security → QA → deploy) em nossos projetos reais, em produção. Esta não é uma vaga de \"treinar modelo\" nem de \"fazer prompt em chatbot\". E engenharia de plataforma com foco em confiabilidade, observabilidade e auto-recuperação  de agentes autônomos rodando 24/7 em produção, escrevendo código de desenvolvimento, fazendo git push, abrindo PRs, mergeando em omolog, fazendo cherry-pick para produção. O que é o Plataforma Agents de IA  Para você decidir se a vaga te interessa, precisa entender o que vai manter: • Orquestrador:  Le as issues (Jira), identifica issues prontas pra cada stage, dispara agentes (Claude/OpenIA/Gemini/DeepSeek) com contexto rico, valida o resultado, posta comentario na issue, e avanca o status. Roda em servidores Linux, com auto-update. • Agentes (@dev, @qa, @sec, @devops, @pm, @po, @sm, @analyst, @architect, @data-engineer, @ux-design-expert):  cada um com persona, authority matrix definida, skills executáveis e Gates de qualidade. • Rules:  Mais de 60 regras formais que governam o comportamento dos agentes — desde naming conventions até anti-hallucination validation em 7 camadas. Cada rule nasce de um bug real anonimizado em produção e tem detector regex + caso aplicação por agent. • Recovery loops:  quando um stage falha (CI quebra, conflict de cherry-pick, working tree dirty, autocompact thrashing), o orquestrador detecta deterministicamente e redispara o agente em --mode=ci_recovery com contexto enriquecido. Cap de tentativas, anti-oscilação, escalada pra humano quando esgota. • Multi-repo via submodules:  projetos clientes tem 2 a 30+ sub-repos. Vertex orquestra cherry-pick coordenado, dependency promotion cross-issue, working-tree auto-recovery, validação de paridade de coverage Sonar. • Stack:  Bash 5+ (nucleo), Python, Node.js/TypeScript (CLIs auxiliares), gh CLI, jq, integrações HTTP com Jira/GitHub via curl + retry policy. O que você vai fazer  Manutenção do core (40%)  • Manter e evoluir fix de bugs, refatorações controladas, redução de complexidade ciclomática. • Garantir que retry policies (Git, PM API, autocompact, recovery loops) continuem determinísticas e sem custo desnecessário. • Manter as integrações com Jira API (ADF, webhooks, transitions, comments via helper canônico) funcionais frente a mudancas de schema/comportamento. • Operar e melhorar o sistema de telemetria (dashboards de custo por agent/stage/issue). • Diagnosticar incidentes em produção (cliente reporta \"agent crashou em loop\", \"PR criado no repo errado\", \"deploy não promoveu\") e fechar com case study anonimizado + nova rule preventiva. Evolução de agents e rules (35%)  • Criar e refinar rules quando bugs sistemicos forem detectados — cada rule nova segue o template canônico (detector regex, aplicação por agent, caso real anonimizado, antipatterns, checklist). • Calibrar prompts dos agents para reduzir alucinação, scope creep, falsos positivos e ciclos de retrabalho. • Manter o agent-authority.md consistente quando authorities mudarem (ex: @dev ganhou ownership de PR contra homolog em v2.0.146). • Criar/refatorar skills. • Medir impacto de cada rule nova (redução de ciclos de retrabalho, custo USD por issue, leakage rate de bugs Categoria A vs B). Integrações com LLM CLIs (25%)  • Manter compatibilidade com mudanças de breaking change dos provedores (Claude Code, OpenAI CLI, Gemini CLI, DeepSeek direct). • Avaliar e integrar novos providers/modelos quando custo-benefício mudar (ex: DeepSeek-Reasoner para recovery loops, Haiku para classificação). • Otimizar custo: identificar stages onde modelo menor resolve. • Implementar fallbacks quando um provider está em outage (ja existe retry transient; expandir cobertura). • Trabalhar com tokenização, context windows, autocompact thrashing detection — entender as falhas reais de cada modelo, não a teoria. O que esperamos de você  Stack técnica — obrigatório  • Bash/Shell avançado e Linux  — você e confortável lendo e escrevendo 500+ linhas de bash com set -euo pipefail, traps, subshells, file locks, jq, awk, sed, heredocs, parameter expansion avançada. Não tem medo de poll.sh. Sabe diferenciar ( ) de ((  e porque importa. • Node.js / TypeScript  — escreve TS com strict mode, entende quando não  usar Node (ex: lógica de orquestração crítica fica em bash justamente porque e mais previsível que async JS). • Git e GitHub avançado  — cherry-pick com -m 1, submodules, gh pr create/merge/edit/list --search, git revert, git rebase --autosquash, resolução de conflicts nao-triviais, branch protection rules, GitHub Actions workflows. • Prompt engineering aplicado a agentes autônomos  — você já calibrou prompts em produção, sabe que \"diga ao modelo o que não  fazer\" raramente funciona, entende o efeito de exemplos few-shot vs zero-shot, e já debugou ao menos uma vez porque um agente está \"alucinando\" um PR que não criou. Experiência  • 5+ anos de engenharia de software produzindo sistemas em produção. • Pelo menos 1 ano com agentes autônomos / orquestração de LLMs  em ambiente real (não bootcamp, não side project) — você sabe a diferença entre \"rodou no demo\" e \"rodou em prod 24/7 sem humano\". • Histórico comprovado de manter sistemas legados com debt técnico — você não quer \"reescrever do zero\". • Inglês técnico fluente para leitura/escrita (documentação, issues, comentários de código em inglês obrigatórios; comunicação verbal pode ser PT/EN/ZH dependendo do time). Mentalidade  • Determinismo > magia.  Você prefere uma regex feia em bash que sempre funciona a um ML model elegante que falha em 5% dos casos. Em orquestração de agentes, 5% de falha = produto inviável. • Forensics sobre intuição.  Antes de propor solução, você lê o log, o diff, a issue real do cliente. Não inventa hipótese. • Documentação executável.  Quando você cria uma rule nova, ela tem detector regex que pode rodar em CI. \"Documentei em texto\" não basta. • Empatia por agente.  Você consegue ler um prompt de 8k tokens e identificar onde o modelo vai se confundir, por que, e o que ajustar. Diferenciais  • Experiencia com Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Agents SDK, LangGraph ou frameworks de orquestração equivalentes. • Já implementou ou manteve sistemas de retry policy + backoff exponencial + circuit breaker  em integrações com APIs externas instáveis. • Já trabalhou com monorepos via submodules  (nao apenas Nx/Turborepo) e entende os trade-offs. • Contribuições open-source em projetos relacionados (CLIs, dev tooling, agent frameworks). • Experiencia com DevOps em servidores Linux dedicados  (não apenas k8s/cloud managed): systemd, cron, logrotate, monitoring com ferramentas leves. • Familiaridade com conventional commits, semantic-release, gitflow trifásico  (feature → homolog → main com cherry-pick). • Já escreveu post-mortem público / case study técnico que outras pessoas referenciam. Benefícios  • VR/VA – Flash Benefícios • Assistência Médica – Bradesco Saúde • Assistência Odontológica – Bradesco • Programa de Orientação Pessoal – C4Life • Day Off de Aniversário • TotalPass • Parcerias educacionais (FIAP e Alura)

Ensure all analytical and AI-driven outputs maintain high standards of quality, transparency, and ethical integrity. Balance innovation with rigor, ensuring new approaches are credible, defensible, and client-ready.  Your profile:  5+ years of professional experience in data analytics, advanced analytics, or market research roles, ideally in a client-facing or consulting environment. Demonstrated ability to work closely with non-technical stakeholders (e.g., research, sales, clients), translating business needs into analytical solutions. Fluency in English is required; additional languages (particularly Portuguese/Spanish) are a strong plus.  **Please submit your CV in English  Our Values:  A cting with Ownership- Demonstrating individual accountability B ringing a forward mindset- Being action-oriented, bold and entrepreneurial C ollaborating with Curiosity- Exhibiting teamwork through togetherness D iscussing openly, committing jointly- Sharing your views openly E mbracing empathy- Being egoless & caring What we offer:  At Toluna, we’re all about creating a welcoming, diverse workplace where everyone can thrive. We offer competitive pay, great benefits, and plenty of opportunities to grow within our global team. Inclusion and respect are at the heart of what we do. Our community connects over 72 million people across 70 countries. If you’re passionate about making an impact, we’d love to have you on board. title: Médico Nefrologista em Telemedicina (com RQE)
description:

*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO NEFROLOGISTA NA TELADOC HEALTH\"  Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!  A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicos e Médicas Especialistas em Nefrologia!  Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando. *SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: * A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas. *O QUE PROCURAMOS: * Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na especialidade de Nefrologia , de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos. *PAPEIS E RESPONSABILIDADES*  Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Nefrologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.   Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios nefrológicos.  Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de: conduzir anmneses virtuais para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de gravidade em Nefrologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.  Habilidade em conduzir entrevistas detalhadas e observar sintomas e sinais da especialidade Nefrologia através de videochamadas.  Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.  Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.  Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças nefrológicas.  Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.  Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.  Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.   Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca de problemas de saúde em Nefrologia.  Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.  Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.  Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.  Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.  Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.   Manter-se bem informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.  Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.   REQUISITOS  Formação Acadêmica:  Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA CONCLUÍDA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO/PÓS EM NEFROLOGIA.  Certificações:  Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM); Certificado de Título de Especialista em Nefrologia - RQE  (Emitido pelo Conselho do respectivo Estado); Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil);  Experiência:   Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Nefrologia, sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina. Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:   Competência em prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios nefrológicos. Competências Comportamentais:  Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional. Outros Requisitos Importantes:   Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável. Local de Trabalho:  REMOTO Remuneração e Agendamentos: a combinar durante processo seletivo. IMPORTANTE:  MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO:  Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo, bem como possuir CRM do respectivo CNPJ ativo. Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Clínico/Generalista Residente em Gastroenterologista.

title: Project Manager
description:
Empresa está contratando Project Manager em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

Ten16 Creative is looking for a mid-level Project Manager based in Brazil to help keep our creative work clear, organized, and moving forward. Ten16 is a creative partner for technology-driven companies, helping teams turn complex products into clear, market-ready brand, campaign, design, web, video, and motion experiences. Our clients operate across areas such as AI, SaaS, gaming, entertainment, consumer electronics, connected hardware, and B2B technology. This is a remote contractor position for someone who is experienced enough to manage multiple moving pieces with confidence, but still hands-on, adaptable, and eager to grow with a fast-moving creative team. The right person will bring structure to creative work without slowing it down. They will help coordinate timelines, deliverables, client communication, internal reviews, production details, and day-to-day follow-through across projects that often involve strategy, design, writing, motion, video, web, and campaign development. About Ten16 CreativeTen16 Creative is a global creative studio with roots in the United States and São Paulo. We help tech-driven companies make complex products easier to understand, trust, and bring to market. Our work spans brand identity, campaign development, design systems, web design, presentations, marketing assets, video, motion, 3D animation, AI-powered production, and creative leadership. We work with companies that need a creative partner who can bring clarity, consistency, and structure to sophisticated products. Our clients have included technology, AI, SaaS, gaming, entertainment, and consumer electronics brands, with representative work across companies and projects in various tech-driven spaces.  About the RoleThe Project Manager will be responsible for helping Ten16 plan, coordinate, and deliver creative projects from kickoff through final delivery. This person will work closely with creative directors, designers, producers, writers, motion teams, developers, and clients to make sure everyone understands what needs to happen, when it needs to happen, and what is required to deliver excellent work. This role is ideal for someone who has already worked in an agency, creative studio, production company, marketing team, or digital product environment and understands how creative work moves from brief to execution. The role does not require senior-level account leadership, but it does require organization, fluent English and Portuguese communication skills, and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.  You will manage active project timelines and ensure that milestones, deliverables, meetings, and reviews are clearly documented and communicated. You will help turn creative scopes into practical schedules, making sure that internal team members understand priorities and that clients understand what is needed from them to keep projects moving. You will coordinate daily and weekly project activity across brand, design, web, video, motion, campaign, and presentation work. This includes assigning or tracking tasks, following up on open items, preparing meeting agendas, documenting decisions, and making sure feedback is captured accurately. You will also help maintain project management tools, shared folders, project boards, calendars, and production documents so the team always has a reliable source of truth. You will support client-facing communication in English with professionalism and clarity. This may include sending status updates, recapping meetings, organizing feedback, preparing for presentations, and helping the team stay ahead of deadlines. Because Ten16 works with technology-driven companies, you should be comfortable working on projects where the subject matter may be complex, technical, or still evolving. You will help protect the quality of the work by making sure deliverables are complete, organized, properly labeled, and ready for review or delivery. You will not be expected to creative-direct the work, but you should have a strong eye for detail and enough creative production experience to recognize when something is missing, unclear, or not ready to send. QualificationsThe ideal candidate has approximately 3–5 years of experience in project management, creative production, account coordination, marketing operations, agency operations, or a related role. They should have experience managing creative deliverables and coordinating cross-functional teams in a remote environment. They must be located in Brazil and must be fluent in both Portuguese and English. English fluency is essential because the role will involve written and spoken communication with U.S.-based team members and clients. Portuguese fluency is equally important for collaboration with Brazil-based team members and vendors.

title: Promo Team Lead - Brazil
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Promo Team Lead - Brazil em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Pocket FM  Pocket FM is the world’s largest audio-series platform, where powerful stories travel effortlessly across languages, cultures, and continents. From India and the US to Europe and beyond, we are redefining how stories are created, discovered, and experienced across the globe, without screens. At our core, we are an AI-powered entertainment company with a deeply human-first philosophy. We believe technology should amplify creativity. Our proprietary AI systems work alongside writers, voice artists, and creative teams to help stories scale globally, faster, smarter, and with cultural depth and emotional integrity intact. Today, Pocket FM is home to a vibrant community of 250+ million listeners, 300,000+ creators, and 100,000+ audio series. With over 140 billion minutes streamed annually, we have emerged as one of the fastest-growing media-tech companies in the world, and we are just getting started. We operate at a massive global scale, but with a startup mindset: curious, fast-moving, and deeply owner-driven. At Pocket FM, teams are encouraged to think boldly, move with intent, and build for long-term impact as we shape the future of audio-first storytelling worldwide. Role Overview  We are looking for a creative and execution-focused Promo Team Lead  to lead the end-to-end creation of promotional ads, trailers, and performance creatives for Pocket FM audio series in the Brazilian market. As a Promo Team Lead, you will manage a team of promo writers, sound engineers, video editors, and dubbing partners to create high-quality promotional ads for Pocket FM audio series. The role requires strong understanding of promo creation, ad storytelling, localization, dubbing workflows, quality control, team management, and creative optimization. You will oversee fresh promo creation, adaptation of ads from other geographies into Brazilian Portuguese, production quality, timely delivery, and reworks for ads that are not meeting performance benchmarks. Key Responsibilities  1. Team Leadership & Creative Direction  Lead and guide promo writers, sound engineers, video editors, and external dubbing partners. Provide creative direction across writing, dubbing, audio mixing, video editing, and final delivery. Ensure the team is well-utilized, motivated, and aligned with business and creative goals. Build a high-ownership culture focused on quality, speed, and performance.  2. Promo Creation & Localization  Oversee the creation of fresh promo ads, trailers, and long-form promotional scripts for audio series. Adapt successful ads from other geographies into Brazilian Portuguese. Ensure all promos are culturally relevant, emotionally engaging, and suitable for Brazilian audiences. Guide the team on hooks, story setup, emotional beats, cliffhangers, and audience entry points.  3. Production & Quality Control  Own the end-to-end promo production process from brief to final asset delivery. Quality check every stage, including writing, dubbing, audio mixing, video creation, and final output. Review scripts, VO/dubbing output, audio edits, video cuts, captions, and final creatives. Ensure every asset meets Pocket FM’s creative, language, production, and performance standards.  4. Dubbing Agency Management  Identify, evaluate, and onboard dubbing agencies for Brazilian Portuguese production. Coordinate with agencies for script handover, voice casting, recording, revisions, and delivery. Review dubbing output for pronunciation, emotion, pacing, tone, and character fit. Track agency timelines, pending deliverables, feedback loops, and final submissions.  5. Performance Reworks & Optimization  Review ads that are not meeting benchmark metrics and identify key creative issues. Create detailed and actionable rework hypotheses to improve ad performance. Suggest improvements such as stronger hooks, sharper conflicts, better pacing, improved localization, or revised visuals. Guide the team in creating alternate openings, new versions, and stronger creative angles. Apply campaign learnings to improve future promo concepts and execution.  6. Process, Tracking & Reporting  Maintain show-level trackers for all ads being written, adapted, dubbed, edited, reviewed, and delivered. Track ownership, status, timelines, delays, feedback, and final delivery for each asset. Share weekly progress reports with the India team and relevant stakeholders. Create SOPs, checklists, and workflows to avoid leakages across the production process.  7. AI Tool Adoption  Use GenAI tools for ad writing, ideation, VO production, image creation, video creation, and workflow improvement. Guide the team in using AI tools to improve speed, quality, and efficiency. Continuously explore new AI tools and workflows for promo production. Ensure AI-assisted outputs are reviewed for storytelling quality, cultural accuracy, and production readiness.  8. Market & Audience Understanding  Apply strong understanding of Brazilian consumer behavior, content consumption habits, and market trends. Ensure promos feel native, relevant, and compelling for Brazilian audiences. Stay updated on digital ads, audio entertainment, trailer formats, and performance creative trends.  Qualifications  Degree in Filmmaking, Marketing, Advertising, Media, Communications, or a related field. 8+ years of experience in ad creation, promo creation, trailer development, marketing creatives, ad copywriting, or performance creative production. Strong understanding of marketing, ad storytelling, promo creation, and audience engagement. Experience leading creative or production teams, including writers, editors, sound engineers, or external vendors. Excellent command of English and Brazilian Portuguese. Strong understanding of Brazilian consumer behavior, content consumption patterns, and cultural nuances. Experience working with dubbing agencies, VO artists, production teams, or post-production vendors. Skilled in GenAI tools for writing, VO production, image creation, video creation, and creative workflow improvement. Ability to create SOPs, trackers, review systems, and scalable creative processes. Strong analytical ability to review ad performance and convert insights into actionable creative reworks. Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and leadership skills. Strategic thinker with strong ownership and business growth orientation. Understanding of performance marketing on Meta and UAC is a plus.  Ideal Candidate  The ideal candidate is a creative leader who understands storytelling, promo production, and performance-driven advertising. They should be able to lead a multi-functional team, manage dubbing partners, maintain strong quality control, and deliver high-quality promo assets at scale. They should have strong knowledge of Brazilian audiences, excellent creative judgment, hands-on production understanding, and the ability to turn performance feedback into clear creative action. Language requirements  Fluent Portugese Professional working proficiency in English  This role will be working with stakeholders in English on a regular basis. Salary for this position is R$ 7,000 - $10,000 BRL.
